subject: Insurance
title: Disaster Relief via Insurance
description: A quick, practical guide to Disaster Relief via Insurance.

hook.text: The Caribbean Catastrophe Risk Insurance Facility pays governments within 14 days of a hurricane.

buildup.text: After a disaster, traditional aid takes months. Governments need cash immediately for rescue, shelter, and clean water.

discovery.text: Sovereign insurance pools let small nations share catastrophe risk.

twist.text: Payouts are based on storm parameters, not actual damage.

climax.text: Sovereign catastrophe insurance replaces slow charity with fast finance.

punchline.text: 14 days to payout after a hurricane. Insurance beats aid every time.

quiz.question: How does the Caribbean catastrophe insurance facility deliver faster relief?
options: By paying governments within 14 days based on storm parameters
